MLP Width Playground

Use the width slider to change how many neurons each hidden layer has, while keeping the depth fixed at 3 hidden layers. The top plot shows the decision boundary, and the bottom plot shows how train and test accuracy change across width.

Current Summary

What Width Means Here

Increasing width means adding more neurons inside each hidden layer, while keeping the number of hidden layers fixed. That lets you compare extra neurons against the separate depth demo.

Discussion Questions

  • What are the features and labels in this dataset?
  • What does increasing width mean here in network terms: more neurons per hidden layer, or more hidden layers?
  • How does width affect model capacity compared to depth?
  • At what width does the model start to overfit, and why?
  • How do train vs test accuracy change as width grows, and how is that similar to or different from changing depth?
  • How would changing the number of training samples affect this?
